definition: Alternative ANN machinery: IVF clusters vectors and searches only relevant clusters; PQ compresses vectors into compact codes.
details: Alternative ANN machinery: IVF clusters vectors and searches only relevant clusters; PQ compresses vectors into compact codes. Combined (IVF-PQ), they trade some recall for dramatic memory savings on huge corpora.

explainer.lead: IVF and product quantization are approximate nearest-neighbor techniques: IVF searches only relevant clusters, and PQ compresses vectors into compact codes. Combined as IVF-PQ, they matter for searching very large corpora within limited memory.

tiers.eli5: Instead of comparing your query with every book in the library, first check the few shelves that look right, and store short summaries of each book rather than the full text.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers combine IVF-PQ to keep huge vector indexes in memory, accepting lower recall; the pitfall is that the compression and cluster pruning both lose accuracy that must be tuned.
tiers.paperLevel: IVF clusters vectors and searches only relevant clusters; PQ compresses vectors into compact codes. Combined, IVF-PQ trades some recall for dramatic memory savings on huge corpora.

explainer.example: A billion-vector search index groups vectors into clusters, probes only the nearest few clusters per query, and compares compressed codes instead of full vectors.
